findings.title: Native runtime check no longer exercises the consumer binary
findings.message: The native runtime benchmark now runs a separately built binary from the SDK's examples/hello instead of the consumer app that was just tested. The runtime check no longer validates the relocated consumer. examples/hello is also not covered by the earlier race/vet checks, and its module resolution (replace directives, go.mod location) differs from the consumer's, so the build can fail or resolve different dependencies.
findings.suggestion: Confirm examples/hello is a standalone module with a valid go.mod inside the SDK and that it is vetted. Otherwise keep benchmarking the consumer binary, or add the diagnostic to the vet/test steps.
findings.evidence: run_child(["go", "build", "-o", str(diagnostic), "."], cwd=sdk / "examples/hello", env=env, check=True, stdout=sys.stderr, timeout=COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
